model.title: Water Project Navigators Act
model.meta: Energy and Natural Resources Committee · Sen. John Hickenlooper (D-CO)

summary.text: The bill would establish a Water Project Navigators Program to help communities access federal funding and technical assistance for water infrastructure projects. It aims to simplify the process for local governments and organizations seeking to develop and finance water-related improvements.
